  - paragraph: On records days, Daniel sat at the far end of our table with a pencil and a stack of labels. He noticed when a donor's photograph had the wrong street written beneath it. He would ask us to keep the old label beside the correction. It was slower. It meant someone coming after him could see why the caption changed.
  - paragraph: Daniel worked with civic records. Last week he sent our editor an older cropped view of a North Quay evacuation record and asked her to keep it. The current public civic copy is linked below. We are sharing only the public-facing rows and covering resident details. We cannot authenticate an entire 2019 file from a cropped image.
  - paragraph: We are publishing this because Daniel is missing, and because people who may have spoken to him about a record should have a safe way to contact us. His family gave permission for this portrait and missing-person notice. Please do not search buildings, follow strangers, or post guesses about where he is.
  - paragraph: The preview is one of the last work items he shared with us. It is incomplete. If you saw Daniel or have information about the record, use this Bulletin's case tip form. You can request an anonymous return token. Tell us what you can point to and where you saw it. You may keep reading without submitting anything. Please do not post a private name or a theory about someone's guilt in the comments. The family needs information that can be checked.
